evidence.text: Gross profit for our international wholesale segment increased $156.9 million, or 16.1%, to $1,133.6 million for 2019 compared to $976.7 million for 2018. Gross margins for the international wholesale segment were 46.0% for 2019 compared to 47.5% for 2018. Gross margins for our international direct subsidiary sales, including our joint ventures, were 50.1% for 2019 as compared to 51.7% for 2018. The decrease was primarily attributable to promotional efforts to clear seasonal inventory in select markets. Gross margins for our international distributor sales were 25.8% for 2019 as compared to 25.9% for 2018.
